ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: settle the score
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Send a force to a hostile settlement and destroy it. It's dangerous and costly, and some colonists will never forgive the bloodshed. This is only proposed while the colony is grieving or has just been raided.

plain.li: They keep coming here. We know where they live. I say we pay a visit.
Every raid, we bury someone and they go home to a hot meal. I want them to lose something too.
[grieving] I dug the grave myself. Now I want to see their walls burn.
[afterraid] They ran home to lick their wounds. Let's follow them there.

warm.li: I hate this. But if we don't stop them, they'll take someone else we love. Let's end it.

blunt.li: Weapons, food, a long walk, and then a big fire. Who's in?
[trait:Bloodlust] I've been sharpening things for weeks. Let's go use them.

cheerful.li: A long walk, a big fight and revenge at the end of it! I'll pack lunch.

gloomy.li: Some of us won't come back. Most of them won't either. That's the trade.

cold.li: A raid base within striking distance is a recurring cost. Remove it and the cost goes away.
[trait:Psychopath] Their settlement has supplies, weapons, people to take. Opportunity, not revenge.

plain.li: Ashes and quiet. They won't come from that direction again.

warm.li: It's over. I hope it's over. Let's go home.

gloomy.li: We won, and it doesn't feel like winning.

cold.li: Threat neutralized. The spoils should cover the ammunition.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: making a name
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Complete two quests: rescues, deliveries, ruins to clear, or whatever else the factions offer. They bring rewards, goodwill and a name people recognize.

plain.li: Offers keep coming in from out there, and we keep ignoring them. Let's take on a couple.
Out there, people pay for help. We could use the pay, and the friends.
[small] We're a handful of people on a big planet. Let's make sure someone out there knows our name.

warm.li: Somebody out there needs help, and we're able to give it. That feels like reason enough.

blunt.li: Quests mean loot, and loot means we eat better this winter.

cheerful.li: Adventure and rewards! Possibly some danger, but mostly the other things.

gloomy.li: Everything out there wants to kill us. Might as well get paid to find out how.

cold.li: Quest rewards are high relative to risk, and goodwill compounds. It's a sound investment.

plain.li: People out there know who we are now. A trader even got our name right.

cheerful.li: Traders have heard of us now! One of them knew the cook's name.
